children: Chaince Digital reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.81 million, up 92% year over year, and net income of $0.23 million, compared with a $2.55 million net loss a year earlier. Gross profit rose 83.3% to $1.39 million, while the operating loss narrowed 43.6%. Revenue for the first nine months reached $2.78 million, exceeding the company’s full-year 2025 revenue.
Third-quarter revenue was $1.81 million, compared with $0.94 million in the prior-year quarter; nine-month revenue was $2.78 million, up 131.4% from $1.20 million.
Third-quarter gross profit was $1.39 million, up 83.3%, with a gross margin of 76.7%.
The third-quarter operating loss narrowed 43.6% year over year.
Third-quarter net income was $0.23 million, compared with a net loss of $2.55 million a year earlier. Nine-month net loss narrowed 58.7% year over year.
At September 30, cash, short-term investments and stablecoins totaled approximately $60.0 million, and shareholders’ equity was $61.7 million, up 40.1% from December 31, 2025.
Underwriter services generated approximately 74% of quarterly revenue and led growth. Transaction execution, brokerage and clearing-related brokerage services also contributed.
Growth in the first nine months reflected underwriter services, industry advisory and consulting, and transaction execution and brokerage. The client base grew approximately 60% year over year.
Chaince continued developing its tokenization platform network, including blockchain architecture and a framework for real-world asset tokenization.
On August 11, the company closed a registered direct offering of 30.56 million ordinary shares. It also repurchased and canceled all outstanding warrants from its November 2023 private placement.
All Filecoin mining nodes had ceased operations by September 30. The company reported no shares sold under its at-the-market offering program and no warrants outstanding as of November 12.
